CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for **Curacast**, which turns a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby library into 24/7 live TV channels with a real programme guide.
Curacast presents itself to Plex as an HDHomeRun tuner, so Plex Live TV discovers it automatically, and it serves M3U and XMLTV for any IPTV client. FFmpeg is bundled, with hardware encoding via VideoToolbox, NVENC, VAAPI and QSV. Images are published for `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`.
Two templates are maintained here: the standard one, and an NVIDIA variant for NVENC transcoding.
Free for 14 days on up to 2 channels. A subscription removes the channel limit. Existing channels are never removed if a licence lapses, and a programme already playing is never interrupted.
Support: [curacast.tv/support](https://curacast.tv/support) or support@inertiatechgroup.com
